text: MySingaporeDriver (mysingaporedriver.com) runs Changi transfers in vehicles from a 3-seat Premium MPV to a 9-seat First-Class Minibus, a 14-seat coaster and a 40-seat field bus. Its family guide lists three seat types: infant capsules for babies up to about 12 months on its executive business van and First-Class Minibus, toddler seats for 9 months to 4 years on all executive vehicles, and booster seats. The driver arrives with the seat already fitted, meets you in the arrival hall with a name sign and helps with the cases. Wheelchair-accessible minibuses and Welcab vehicles are available on request.

text: Black Car Service Singapore (blackcarservicesingapore.com) lists Changi's arrival pick-up points terminal by terminal, from Basement 1 at T1 and T3 to Level 1 at T2 and T4, and confirms the exact door for each booking in writing before you fly. With tired children and a trolley of cases, that saves the walk around the arrival hall looking for the car. A 3-seat Honda Stepwagon is S$113 on arrival, a 4-seat Toyota Vellfire S$132 and an 8-seat Farizon minibus S$163, and the first 45 minutes after landing are free.
